extracted.intended_audience: journalists, partner organizations, designers, and communications/marketing staff preparing media materials for Boys & Girls Clubs of Broward County
extracted.subtask_description: Brand and media guidelines for producing press and communications materials for Boys & Girls Clubs of Broward County, covering logo use, color palette, typography, messaging (mission/vision/core values), social media tags, and contact points. Intended to ensure consistent visual and verbal identity across communications channels.

rubrics_metrics.name: Brand guideline purpose and rulebook
rubrics_metrics.description: This guide explains the visual communications standards that comprise BGCBC’s brand identity. It serves as a rulebook to help maintain brand integrity across communications channels.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you have any questions not answered in the guide, please contact BGCBC’s Marketing and Communications Department at Marketing@bgcbc.org.

rubrics_metrics.name: Logo — composition and meaning
rubrics_metrics.description: Our logo is the simplest expression of BGCA’s brand. It consists of two elements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: THE CLASPED HANDS SYMBOL: Represents the guiding hands that Boys & Girls Clubs of Broward County extend to youth. Use the logo as the primary visual identifier; respect the symbolism and do not alter the core elements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Logo — approved versions and downloads
rubrics_metrics.description: Downloadable approved logo variants are provided for use in different contexts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Available versions: Vertical Version, White Vertical Version, Black Vertical Version, Horizontal Version, White Horizontal Version, Black Horizontal Version. Use the appropriate version for background/color context and do not create unapproved variants. 'Download Logos' provided on the press kit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Color palette — primary color
rubrics_metrics.description: PRIMARY COLOR: Pantone Process Blue is our primary color.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Color specs: Pantone Process Blue; CMYK: 100/13/2/0; RGB: 0/129/198; HEX: #0081C6; Paint: Valspar™ 5001-10C Deep Blue Sea. Use the primary color for core brand elements to uphold brand recognition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Color palette — accent colors and usage
rubrics_metrics.description: ACCENT COLORS: The accent colors are primarily used for clarity in data visualization or when additional color is needed to differentiate information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Accent colors listed with specifications: Pantone 376 C — CMYK: 54/0/100/0; RGB: 132/189/0; HEX: #84BD00. Pantone 2492 C — CMYK: 58/90/0/0; RGB: 155/38/182; HEX: #9B26B6. Pantone Orange 151 C — CMYK: 0/60/100/0; RGB: 255/130/0; HEX: #FF8200. Pantone Cool Gray 11 C — CMYK: 44/34/22/77; RGB: 83/86/90; HEX: #53565A. Pantone 301 C — CMYK: 100/53/4/19; RGB: 0/75/135; HEX: #004B87. Other colors may be used to suit the visual identity and messaging, but accents should mainly serve clarity and differentiation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Typography — print and web standards
rubrics_metrics.description: Typography is essential to establishing the character of the brand and making it recognizable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For print, Franklin Gothic font family is the preferred typeface. For web, Helvetica Neue or Arial font families are the preferred typefaces. Other typefaces may be used as long as they are readable and improve the visual identity or messaging.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mission — messaging anchor
rubrics_metrics.description: Our Mission: To enable all youth, especially those who need us most, to reach their full potential as productive, caring and responsible citizens.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the mission as a core messaging anchor in communications and media materials to reflect organizational purpose and tone.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vision — messaging goal
rubrics_metrics.description: Our Vision: To provide a world class Club experience that assures that success is within reach of every young person who walks through our doors, with all members on track to graduate from high school with a plan for the future, demonstrating good character & citizenship and living a healthy lifestyle.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Incorporate vision language to convey long-term goals and outcomes for members; align program descriptions and success stories to this aspirational statement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Core values to inform content
rubrics_metrics.description: Core Values: Academic Success; Character & Leadership; Health & Well-Being; Life & Workforce Readiness.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Frame program descriptions, outcomes, and storytelling around these four core value areas to keep messaging consistent and mission-aligned.

rubrics_metrics.name: Social media usage — handles, hashtags, and actions
rubrics_metrics.description: 'Let's Get Social!' guidance for social media engagement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Calls to action: Follow us today! Tag Us, Mention Us, Like & Share. Social handle: @BGCOFBROWARD. Hashtags: #BGCBC, #ShapingFutures, #GreatFutures, #WhateverItTakes. Use these handles/hashtags in announcements and social posts to amplify and track engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media contacts and leadership for press inquiries
rubrics_metrics.description: Leadership contacts are listed for media reference.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Named leadership: Chris Gentile, Co-CEO; Matt Organ, Co-CEO. For general brand/marketing questions contact Marketing@bgcbc.org. Use provided contact points for interview requests, quotes, or media coordination.
